name: Project Identity
distinct_validation_purpose: Proves a Project identity and coordination scope without treating the Project as its Product, Method, Goal, Bounded Context, or containing directory.

orthogonality_rules.statement: Project identity is supplied only by project_id and never by directory placement.
A Project coordinates work but does not own Product or Method meaning.
Product and Goal participation must be expressed through separate identity-graph relations.

four_facets.classification: Project Identity is an Artifact Type registration under admitted Artifact Type/v2; its identity, semantic kind, authority kind, and lifecycle posture are explicit independent fields.
four_facets.schema: schema.json is a closed Draft 2020-12 contract for project.json; dependent identities are references or graph relations rather than inferred labels.
four_facets.human_continuation: PROJECT.md is generated deterministically from the canonical machine instance and adds no canonical field.
four_facets.machine_checkable: Schema closure, admitted Definition bindings, explicit identity, hostile collapse/inference rejection, semantic checks, and projection parity are executable.

typed_residue.missing: No artifact-type-owner decision admits Project Identity/v1.
typed_residue.consequence: Future identity instances cannot rely on Project Identity/v1 as an admitted type.

typed_residue.missing: No CML-07 S3 Craft identity carrier has been materialized.
typed_residue.consequence: Fixture validity must not be reported as a real Craft identity or identity-contract conformance.

claim_ceiling: This package is a Project Identity/v1 Artifact Type candidate. PASS establishes only candidate schema-and-artifact-type-contract conformance for its exact package and fixtures; it does not admit the type or any instance, execute S3, establish identity-contract, implementation, or runtime conformance, publish, deploy, or establish a stable release.
